subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should `feishu_drive info` gain a folder-scoped lookup contract that paginates within a supplied shared folder, or should users be directed to use `list` pagination instead?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the remaining fix changes the user-facing `info` tool contract and touches the intentionally avoided bot-root behavior.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose a narrow `folder_token` contract for `info`, paginate only that concrete folder, and document that root lookup is not automatically drained for bot credentials.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Document `list` pagination as the supported way to locate files in shared folders and close or narrow the remaining `info` request.

options.title: Design a separate lookup tool
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers choose a different file lookup surface that can handle folder scope, permissions, and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow `folder_token` contract for `info`, paginate only that concrete folder, and document that root lookup is not automatically drained for bot credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: He landed the list half and already documented the remaining folder-aware `info` decision on the issue.
